items.question: How do members pay?
items.answer: By UPI Autopay, card e-mandate or eNACH, monthly or yearly. By default renewals go straight to your own Razorpay account, and {{brand.name}} bills its 5% afterwards.

items.question: What can a membership include?
items.answer: A member price on sessions, up to 100% off so they’re included; early booking; and sessions only members can book. You can add perks you give in person, like a free mat or a guest pass.

items.question: Can members pause?
items.answer: Yes. Members pause or cancel at the end of their period themselves. You can also pause billing for everyone, for a month off or the monsoon.

items.question: Can {{brand.name}} run my whole weekly timetable?
items.answer: Each class is its own session on {{brand.name}}, so a busy timetable is more work than in a class-booking tool. Many studios start with workshops, socials and the classes members come to most.

items.question: Do you sell class packs?
items.answer: Not yet. Memberships with a member price or included sessions cover most of what packs are used for.

items.question: Do members need an app?
items.answer: No. Members join, book and check in on your page in their phone’s browser.
